title: Single-cell imaging of protein dynamics of paralogs reveals mechanisms of gene retention
authors: Dandage R; Papkov M; Greco BM; Fishman D; Friesen H; Wang K; Styles E; Kraus O; Grys B; Boone C; Andrews B; Parts L; Kuzmin E
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞成像分析旁系同源蛋白的定位与丰度变化，探讨基因保留机制，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Gene duplication is common across the tree of life, including yeast and humans, and contributes to genomic robustness. In this study, we examined changes in the subcellular localization and abundance of proteins in response to the deletion of their paralogs originating from the whole-genome duplication event, which is a largely unexplored mechanism of functional divergence. We performed a systematic single-cell imaging analysis of protein dynamics and screened subcellular redistribution of proteins, capturing their localization and abundance changes, providing insight into forces determining paralog retention. Paralogs showed dependency, whereby proteins required their paralog to maintain their native abundance or localization, more often than compensation. Network feature analysis suggested the importance of functional redundancy and rewiring of protein and genetic interactions underlying redistribution response of paralogs. Translation of non-canonical protein isoform emerged as a novel compensatory mechanism. This study provides new insights into paralog retention and evolutionary forces that shape genomes.
abstract_zh: 基因重复在生命之树中普遍存在，包括酵母和人类，并有助于基因组稳健性。在本研究中，我们考察了响应于全基因组重复事件产生的旁系同源基因缺失时，蛋白质亚细胞定位和丰度的变化，这是一种在很大程度上尚未探索的功能分化机制。我们进行了蛋白质动力学的系统性单细胞成像分析，并筛选了蛋白质的亚细胞再分布，捕获了它们的定位和丰度变化，为决定旁系同源基因保留的力量提供了见解。旁系同源基因表现出依赖性，即蛋白质需要其旁系同源基因来维持其天然丰度或定位，这种情况比补偿更为常见。网络特征分析提示，功能冗余以及蛋白质和遗传相互作用的重新布线在旁系同源基因的再分布响应中具有重要意义。非经典蛋白质亚型的翻译出现作为一种新的补偿机制。本研究为旁系同源基因保留及塑造基因组的进化力量提供了新见解。
